description: List upcoming tech events and earnings days from Techmeme's events calendar (techmeme.com/events). Returns each event's date range, name, location, link (Techmeme /r2/ redirect href, followable in a browser), and a featured flag for sponsored rows; earnings days (names starting with "Earnings: ") and VIRTUAL/HYBRID online events are included in the same list. Takes --limit (1-200, default 50). The page is a single full list (~144 events covering about 5 months) with no pagination, so when fewer events are available than requested the returned items carry partial:true. No login, no browser, no API key required.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-200, default 50). The events page is a single-page list (~144 rows covering roughly 5 months); when fewer events are available than the requested limit, the command returns everything it found and each item is marked partial:true.
